positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
- Led the end-to-end development of the TurboTax Beat Your Price 2024 preseason campaign, designing and building a responsive frontend web application using React and TypeScript. Integrated with shell service rendering, improving LCP(Largest contentful paint) from 20s to 6.5s.
- Solely developed A/B tests for 8 different UI treatments on the TurboTax login page using JavaScript and React, driving higher revenue and increasing higher successful authentication and user creation  rates. https://myturbotax.intuit.com/
- Worked as the team's subject matter expert in Akamai CDN configuration, optimizing edge workers, CDN rules, and web security for TurboTax’s login page.
- Designed and developed a backend service in Kotlin (in collaboration with the Tech Lead) which has APIs to  generate a personalized tax document checklist for TurboTax Full-Service customers.
- Authored 5+ architectural design documents, enabling collaboration across multiple teams and influencing key product decisions.
- Single handedly developed frontend web application using Javascript that allows Turbotax customers to upload Tax documents, which are then auto-applied to their tax returns.
- Developed a tax filing progress tracking feature and integrated it into TurboTax’s global navigation by implementing a Kotlin-based rule, leading to a 5% increase in Start-to-Completion (S2C) rate.
- Key contributor to the TurboTax Super Bowl 2023 campaign, developing multiple web pages tailored to the initiative and integrating the TurboTax login page with Queue-it to manage traffic surges.
- Engaged with modern tooling such as Jest & Cypress for testing, Docker & Kubernetes for deployment, and React & Spring for full stack development.
- Recognized as a top performer, ranking in the top 20% of engineers at Intuit annually.

positions.title: Software Engineer 1
positions.description:
- Led the development of front end project using Typescript & React to provide better insight on the required documents for TurboTax customers to file their taxes successfully.
- Developed backend REST APIs using Kotlin and Springboot for Turbotax’s new product BizTax.
- Engage with a variety of modern technologies such as React, Typescript & Spring for application development, Jest, mockito & Cypress for Test Driven Development, AWS, Docker & Kubernetes for deployment, Karate for functional testing.
- Investigated and discovered the cause of several high‑priority issues by searching backend & frontend logs via Splunk.

positions.title: Summer 2020 Intern - Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed a GitHub Automation full stack application using React and AWS lambda service for Core TurboTax team by implementing a CI/CD pipeline to automatically merge changes into repositories made by the marketing team. 
•	The application reduces the time of the whole process from 24-36 Hours to 2 hours by creating the pull request and commits automatically. It also eliminates the need of long e-mail threads and errors arising out of manual updation.
•	Successfully designed and developed a server using AWS lambda in NodeJs which can interacts with Intuit’s GitHub APIs, by implementing SDLC including deployment pipeline using AGI (build and deployment service by Intuit), setting up API gateway infrastructure, storing and accessing secrets from IDPS (Intuit Data Protection Service) and IP whitelisting.
•	Developed various product features for core TurboTax team and participating in front-end and back-end development.
